listing_info.description:
The Harvey Loft 303 pays homage to the Harvey’s Department Store that occupied 506 Church Street from the 1940s until the 1980s. Fred Harvey Sr. started his business at this location and turned it into one of Nashville’s most beloved shopping locations.

Every stay at 506 Lofts helps someone experiencing homelessness in Nashville through our Rooms for Rooms program! The average weekend stay provides 16 nights in a bed, 100 free showers, or 30 free meals!

The space
This 880 SF loft features 16 foot high ceilings and has amazingly married the aesthetics of a 130 year old building with the modern finishes today’s travelers desire. Loft 303 sleeps up to 6 guests. It has 2 bedrooms (one with a Queen bed & one with a King bed), one Queen sleeper sofa in the living room, a full kitchen, and 2 full bathrooms!

Guest access
Prior to your arrival, you will receive a unique key code that will give you access to the property. This code will unlock the main door to the building, your unit, as well as the stairwell door and elevator.

Although there is no on-site parking, there is a wide array of parking options nearby. Upon booking your stay, we will send you a detailed parking guide.

*Note: This loft has large overhead skylight windows (that let in tons of natural sunlight) instead of standard wall windows. The skylight window in the bedroom even has a fancy remote control shade so you can block the morning sun if desired!

We require Friday and Saturday nights to be booked in the same reservation unless the reservation is for 5 nights or longer. Under certain scenarios we can make exceptions to this, so please ask if you are looking to check-in or out on Saturday.

Our spacious boho chic condo is located in the heart of the city yet off of Broadway a few blocks so you can relax in a quiet space.

The space
Our historic condo has 1145 sq ft of open living space and is full of character with exposed brick walls throughout, wood floors and tall windows.

Both bathrooms have quality sample size amenities in case you forgot to pack something!

There is a coin operated washer and dryer in the basement of the building. Just take the elevator down to access them.

We have a parking spot available in a garage just one block from the condo. A fob will be provided in the condo upon check in.

Watauga Condos are located on the edge of downtown Nashville in a historic building originally called Watauga Flats. Built in 1900 as part of President James Polks’ property, the building has since served as a hotel then housed legislators before being converted into apartments and finally, into condos.

Our historic building still has the charming antique elevator with the brass gate! I’m

The convenience of the keyless entry takes you into the secure lobby. Take either the original antique elevator or the stairs up to the second floor where there is also easy keyless entry into the condo.

listing_info.listing_name: Historic Southern Turf Building - Loft 202
listing_info.description:
Featuring 2 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, you'll immediately be struck by this 945 sqft loft's design that harmoniously combines vintage elements with contemporary aesthetics. While the loft preserves its historical character, modern amenities have not been overlooked. A fully equipped kitchen boasts state-of-the-art appliances, allowing you to indulge your culinary aspirations. The spacious living area offers comfortable seating and a large flat-screen TV.

The space
Welcome to the legendary Southern Turf Building in the heart of downtown Nashville, Tennessee! Nestled just above historic Skull's Rainbow Room (a Nashville landmark since 1948) and Nashville's newest and most elevated dining experience, Sinatra Bar & Lounge, we are thrilled to offer you a unique Airbnb experience with our six exquisite lofts that showcase the rich history and vibrant culture of this iconic city. Relax in comfort and indulge in the history and charm of the historic Southern Turf Building. Each of our lofts has been meticulously renovated by Icon Entertainment & Hospitality to provide a custom guest experience. The legendary Southern Turf Building holds a special place in Nashville's history, dating back to its construction in the late 19th century. Over the years, it has been a gathering place for locals and visitors alike, hosting vibrant music performances, lively events and unforgettable moments. Now, as part of Icon Entertainment's vision, these units combine the building's storied past with modern amenities and luxurious touches. We strive to provide you with an unforgettable stay, where you can immerse yourself in the soulful rhythms of Music City while enjoying the comfort and convenience of our thoughtfully designed accommodations. As our guest, you'll have access to all the amenities you need, including high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, essential toiletries and a concierge service ready to assist you throughout your stay. All our lofts feature antique accents and select furnishings from the 1800's as an homage to the heritage of the Southern Turf Building. There's no limit to the live entertainment and delectable cuisine located not just in walking distance but within the same historic building as the lofts. The first floor is home to the Manhattan meets Palm Springs ambiance of Sinatra Bar & Lounge, a homage to Frank Sinatra serving classic Italian, prime steaks and classic cocktails. Head to the basement of the Southern Turf Building to experience the fine dining, craft cocktails and live entertainment (featuring live jazz nightly and burlesque performances every weekend) that has made Skull's the cornerstone of Nashville's historic Printers Alley district since 1948. Come experience the magic of Nashville from the legendary Southern Turf Building, where history, music and hospitality converge.

Other things to note
Your stay at the Southern Turf Lofts will include the following:

Food & Beverage credit for Skull's Rainbow Room
Food & Beverage credit for Sinatra Bar & Lounge
Complimentary admission to the Johnny Cash Museum
Exclusive guest pass to the Southern Turf Private Club
